name: FERRUM PICRICUM
key_symptoms: Indigestion, furred tongue, headache after meals, especially in bilious, dark-haired persons.
Pain in right side of neck and down right arm. Locomotor ataxia, ocular stage. Hands covered with warts.
guiding_symptoms: Indigestion, furred tongue, headache after meals, especially in bilious, dark-haired persons.
Pain in right side of neck and down right arm. Locomotor ataxia, ocular stage. Hands covered with warts.
head_symptoms: Deafness before menses. Crackling in ears and low-pitched voice. Vascular deafness. Dental neuralgia, radiating towards ears and eyes. Humming in ears as from telegraph wires. Tinnitus.
gi_symptoms: Indigestion, furred tongue, headache after meals, especially in bilious, dark-haired persons.
urinary_symptoms: Pain along entire urethra. Frequent micturition at night, with full feeling and pressure in rectum. Smarting at neck of bladder and penis (Barosma). Retention of urine.
musculoskeletal_symptoms: Pain in right side of neck and down right arm. Locomotor ataxia, ocular stage. Hands covered with warts.
